explication: Hister is a private personal search engine. Users submit visited pages through the browser extension, import or crawl web and local content, then the server extracts and indexes full text. Search requests from the web app, terminal/TUI, or MCP are authenticated, parsed, and resolved against persistent indexes, with results returned to the initiating client. The tree supports crawler, extractor, rules, history, multi-user OAuth, imports, and optional semantic search; some connections remain generalized because their implementing handlers were not sampled.
